title: Image Compressor
description: A browser-based image compressor: drag in photos or screenshots, tune quality/format/size, and download the result — all client-side, nothing ever gets uploaded.

title: Cron Builder
description: A visual cron expression builder: set minute/hour/day/month/weekday rules with buttons and chips, get a plain-English explanation, and preview the next 5 run times.

title: Regex Tester
description: A regex tester with live match highlighting (including nested capture groups), named groups broken out per match, and a clickable cheat sheet plus a library of common patterns.

title: Color Palette Generator
description: Generate an accessible tonal palette from a base color or an uploaded image's dominant colors, with live WCAG contrast-ratio checks for every shade.

title: Password Generator
description: Generate strong random passwords or memorable passphrases with a live entropy breakdown — bits, total combinations, and estimated crack time — all computed client-side.

title: EXIF Viewer & Editor
description: View every EXIF/metadata field hiding in your JPEG and PNG photos — camera, exposure, timestamps, GPS location — then edit, delete, or add fields, or strip it all out losslessly, straight from the raw file bytes, with nothing ever uploaded.

title: Text Diff Checker
description: Compare two blocks of text side-by-side with word- or character-level highlighting, ignore-case/whitespace options, collapsible unchanged lines, and one-click copy of the diff.

title: Unit / Currency / Timezone Converter
description: Three converters in one: length/weight/temperature/volume/area/speed/data/time units, live currency exchange rates, and a DST-aware timezone converter for comparing times across cities.

title: Social Links
description: I wanted to create a simple website that brought all my social links together, essentially working like a personal Linktree that I could share on my social profiles and make it easy for people to find me online.

title: Gerador de CPF
description: Generates mathematically valid Brazilian CPF numbers (correct check digits) for software testing, with a fiscal-region selector.

title: IG Relationship Checker
description: A web-based tool that analyzes your IG followers and following data. Upload your IG data export to identify mutual friends, inactive accounts, and who doesn't follow you back.
